istem: Tantuni: finely chopped beef stir-fried, wrapped in thin lavash flatbread, with tomatoes, parsley and onion
Testi kebabı: Cappadocian clay pot kebab, a sealed terracotta jug cracked open, lamb and vegetable stew
Cağ kebabı: horizontally roasted lamb slices on a long metal skewer, with lavash, onions and tomatoes
Etliekmek: very long thin flatbread with minced meat topping cut in slices, from Konya
Ali Nazik kebabı: smoky eggplant yogurt puree topped with ground meat kebab and butter
Perde pilavı: dome-shaped rice pilaf baked in a thin pastry crust with chicken and almonds, sliced open
İskender kebab: doner slices over pide bread with tomato sauce, melted butter and yogurt
Hamsi tava: pan-fried anchovies arranged in a circle in a pan, with lemon
